_comment: Hand-keyed ball / action centre for fb-demo/pano-anzhi-goal/pano.mp4 (prep --from 22:52:20): [clip media ms, panorama px, py]. 62.0–70.0 s is the ball itself, read frame by frame (small white moving blob, 3-frame differencing): through ball to the winger, run to the byline, cross struck at ≈65.8 s (lofted — the px rise with the ball), header back across goal at the far post ≈68.1 s, bounce 68.7 s, poked in ≈68.9 s; the ball crosses the line at ≈69.0 s (right goal) and comes to rest in the net at 69.9 s. Anzhi's players raise their arms at 69.6 s. The goal candidate is injected at 69.5 s (alfheim-events --inject goal@69.5:B — the ball ≥ 1 m behind the line for 0.4 s, as the goal rule reads it; the airborne samples unproject off the pitch, so the rule itself stays blind here). Before 62 s and after 70 s it is the action centre by eye. Refine in scripts/fb-ball-keyframes.html, rebuild with scripts/fb-ball-keyframes.mjs.
